verdict.rationale: Docs confirm dedicated VS Code and JetBrains extensions providing inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, and conversation history directly in the editor, and the GitHub README explicitly states Claude Code can be used 'in your terminal, IDE, or tag @claude on Github.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically of the IDE chat experience (community evidence in the pack focuses on CLI/terminal use, not IDE integration).
